audience: event organisers who sell tickets with Billetweb

useCases.title: Check how many seats are left for an event
useCases.text: List the events of the organiser, then read the remaining places per session and per ticket type. Use the numbers to answer how many seats are left.

useCases.title: Find who has not checked in for a session
useCases.text: List the sessions of an event, then list its attendees filtered by session and by check-in state. Use the list to see who has not arrived yet.

useCases.title: Check attendees in or out at the entrance
useCases.text: Find the ticket id of an attendee in the attendee list. Then set the ticket to checked in, checked out or not checked in.

useCases.title: Review sales, refunds and payouts for a period
useCases.text: Read the sales and refunds of a period, then list the payouts. Open one payout to see each sale, refund and fee line.

useCases.title: Send payment requests for unpaid reservations
useCases.text: Find the unpaid reservation orders in the attendee list. Then send each buyer a payment request email. Billetweb cannot recall the email once it is sent.

useCases.title: Create offline orders for guests
useCases.text: List the ticket types of an event, then create offline orders paid by cash, card or invitation. Pass a request id, because a retry creates a second order.
